FROM coollabsio/openclaw:latest

# Install required runtime deps
RUN apt-get update && \
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y \
      ca-certificates curl unzip sqlite3 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install QMD globally via npm (more reliable than bun global in containers)
# Node/npm are already present in the base image (your logs show Node.js v22.x)
RUN npm install -g @tobilu/qmd

# Confirm install
RUN which qmd && qmd --help >/dev/null
